name: Skoura
hero_subtitle: Palm grove, scattered ksars and tracks between the trees — best with a local driver.

overview.title: A Sea of Palms East of Town
overview.p1: Skoura is less a single monument than a wide palm oasis east of Ouarzazate. Ksars rise among the trees; tracks weave between gardens and dry walls. The pleasure is the density of green after the bare plains, and the slower tempo once you leave the main road.
overview.p2: A half-day with a driver who knows the grove is worth more than a rushed photo stop at the first kasbah you see. Amridil is the name you will hear most for a visit inside a historic house.
overview.p3: Midday in summer is heavy under the palms too — morning or late afternoon is more comfortable.

3.desc: Why a local driver changes the visit.

q2.question: Do I need a guide?
q2.answer: A driver familiar with the tracks is strongly recommended.

q3.question: Can I visit Amridil?
q3.answer: Yes — it is the best-known kasbah visit inside the grove; confirm hours.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at Skoura?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for history and safe paths on fragile mud brick.

q5.question: Is Skoura suitable for families?
q5.answer: Yes with supervision on steps, rooftops and uneven ground.

food.title: Simple stops in the grove
food.p1: A few places offer tea and basic meals near visited ksars. For more choice, eat in Ouarzazate before or after.
food.p2: Do not expect a long restaurant row — this is an oasis, not a resort strip.
food.li2: Water in the car at all times
food.li3: Tagine if a kitchen is clearly active
food.li4: Lunch back in town for more options
food.li5: Fruit from a local stall if it looks fresh

1.title: Driver first
1.desc: GPS is not enough between irrigation channels and unsigned tracks. Agree a half-day price from Ouarzazate.

2.title: Amridil
2.desc: If you visit one interior, make it this one — ask for current ticket and photo rules.

3.title: Pace
3.desc: Skoura rewards slow driving and short walks, not a checklist of every wall.
